<thought>From the 13C NMR data, only one carbon signal falls in the typical methyl region (≈10‑30 ppm): 26.41 ppm. The other low‑field signals (36‑38 ppm) are likely methine or quaternary carbons, not methyls. Thus the molecule contains a single methyl group.</thought>
<final_answer>1</final_answer>
